examples.chinese: 我的阿姨在北京工作，她是一名医生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de āyí zài Běijīng gōngzuò, tā shì yī míng yīshēng.
examples.english: My aunt works in Beijing, and she is a doctor.

english: particle: used in direct address and exclamation; indicating obviousness/impatience/suggestion; used for confirmation

examples.chinese: 你怎么还没来啊？我们都等了半小时了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme háishi méi lái a? Wǒmen dōu děng le bàn xiǎoshí le.
examples.english: Why haven't you arrived yet? We've been waiting for half an hour!

examples.chinese: 我们应该培养年轻一代的爱国精神。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi péiyǎng niánqīng yī dài de àiguó jīngshén.
examples.english: We should cultivate the patriotic spirit in the younger generation.

examples.chinese: 他个子很矮，但是他很聪明，在班里学习成绩最好。
examples.pinyin: Tā gèzi hěn ǎi, dànshì tā hěn cōngming, zài bānlǐ xuéxí chéngjì zuì hǎo.
examples.english: He is short in stature, but he is very smart and has the best academic performance in the class.

examples.chinese: 我们要爱护学校的图书馆，这样才能让更多人享受到知识。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào àihù xuéxiào de túshūguǎn, zhèyàng cáinéng ràng gèngduō rén xiǎngshòu dào zhīshi.
examples.english: We should cherish the school library so that more people can enjoy access to knowledge.

examples.chinese: 那个矮小的男孩在班级里总是坐在前面。
examples.pinyin: Nàge ǎixiǎo de男孩 zài bānj í lǐ zǒngshì zuòzài qiánmiàn.
examples.english: That short and small boy always sits in front of the class.

examples.chinese: 他每天都按时到公司上班，从来没有迟到过。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu ànshí dào gōngsī shàngbān, cóngláI méiyǒu chídào guò.
examples.english: He arrives at the company on time every day and has never been late.

examples.chinese: 公司为新员工安置了宿舍和办公室。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī wèi xīn yuángōng ānzhì le sùshè hé bàngōngshì.
examples.english: The company arranged accommodation and an office for the new employees.

examples.chinese: 她的语气暗示她对这个计划并不满意。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yǔqì ànshì tā duì zhège jìhuà bìngbù mǎnyì.
examples.english: Her tone hinted that she was not satisfied with this plan.

examples.chinese: 安老师今天教我们语法。
examples.pinyin: Ān lǎoshī jīntiān jiāo wǒmen yǔfǎ.
examples.english: Teacher An is teaching us grammar today.

examples.chinese: 我昨天在百货商店买了一些日用品。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān zài bǎihuò shāngdiàn mǎile yīxiē rìyòngpǐn.
examples.english: I bought some daily necessities at a general merchandise store yesterday.

examples.chinese: 这个房间太暗了，我看不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān tài àn le, wǒ kànbù qīngchu.
examples.english: This room is too dark/unclear, I can't see clearly.

examples.chinese: 请把这些书摆在书架上。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhèxiē shū bǎi zài shūjià shang.
examples.english: Please place these books on the bookshelf.

examples.chinese: 风吹树枝摆动，树叶也跟着摇晃。
examples.pinyin: Fēng chuī shùzhī bǎidòng, shùyè yě跟着 yáohuàng.
examples.english: The wind blew the tree branches swaying, and the leaves also shook along with them.

examples.chinese: 我每天坐巴士去上班，大约需要半小时。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zuò bāshì qù shàngbān, dàyuē xūyào bàn xiǎoshí.
examples.english: I take the bus to work every day, which takes about half an hour.

examples.chinese: 他终于摆脱了那份无聊的工作，开始了新的生活。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú bǎituōle nà fèn wúliáo de gōngzuò, kāishǐle xīn de shēnghuó.
examples.english: He finally got rid of that boring job and started a new life.

examples.chinese: 他在政府部门办事已经有十年的工作经验了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài zhèngfǔ bùmén bàn shì yǐjīng yǒu shí nián de gōngzuò jīngyàn le.
examples.english: He has ten years of work experience handling affairs in a government department.

examples.chinese: 妈妈把礼物包裹得很漂亮，我迫不及待地想打开。
examples.pinyin: Māma bǎ lǐwù bāoguǒ de hěn piàoliàng, wǒ pòbùjídài de xiǎng dǎkāi.
examples.english: Mom wrapped the gift so beautifully that I can't wait to open it.

examples.chinese: 我们的球队在比赛中以3:1败给了对方。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de qiúduì zài bǐsài zhōng yǐ 3:1 báigěile duìfāng.
examples.english: Our team lost 3:1 to the other team in the match.

examples.chinese: 这个旅游套餐包括酒店、机票和三餐。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lǚyóu tàop餐 bāokuò jiǔdiàn, jīpiào hé sān cān.
examples.english: This travel package includes the hotel, airfare, and three meals.

examples.chinese: 这个古董是我家最珍贵的宝。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǔdòng shì wǒ jiā zuì zhēnguì de bǎo.
examples.english: This antique is the most precious treasure in my family.

examples.chinese: 这个套餐包含早餐和晚餐。
examples.pinyin: Zhège tàocān bāohán zǎocān hé wǎncān.
examples.english: This package includes breakfast and dinner.

examples.chinese: 我的宝宝很可爱，我每天都要给它喂食。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de bǎobao hěn kěài, wǒ měi tiān dōu yào gěi tā wèi shí.
examples.english: My pet is very cute, and I have to feed it every day.

examples.chinese: 这个古老的手镯是我奶奶留下来的宝贝，我一直小心地保护它。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǔlǎo de shǒuzhuó shì wǒ nǎinai liúxiàlái de bǎobèi, wǒ yìzhí xiǎoxīn de bǎohù tā.
examples.english: This ancient bracelet is a treasured object left behind by my grandmother, and I have always carefully protected it.

examples.chinese: 时间是最宝贵的财富，我们应该好好珍惜。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiān shì zuì bǎoguì de cáifù, wǒmen yīnggāi hǎohāo zhēnxī.
examples.english: Time is the most valuable treasure, and we should cherish it well.

examples.chinese: 这条项链上镶嵌着几颗闪闪发光的宝石。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiàngliàn shang xiānghè zhe jǐ kē shǎnshǎn fāguāng de bǎoshí.
examples.english: There are several sparkling precious stones embedded on this necklace.

examples.chinese: 我的父亲很保守，他不太喜欢新的变化。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fùqin hěn bǎoshǒu, tā búài xǐhuān xīn de biànhuà.
examples.english: My father is quite conservative; he doesn't really like new changes.

examples.chinese: 妈妈抱着小孩子在公园里散步。
examples.pinyin: Māmā báozhe xiǎo háizi zài gōngyuán lǐ sànbù.
examples.english: The mother carries her young child in her arms while taking a walk in the park.

examples.chinese: 你需要了解这个问题的背景才能做出正确的决定。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xūyào liǎojiě zhège wèntí de bèijǐng cái néng zuòchū zhèngquè de juéding.
examples.english: You need to understand the context of this issue in order to make the right decision.

examples.chinese: 今年的销售额比去年增长了三倍。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de xiāoshòué bǐ qùnián zēngzhǎngle sān bèi.
examples.english: This year's sales revenue increased threefold compared to last year.

examples.chinese: 这个项目很重要，请大家一定要保密，不能告诉任何人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù hěn zhòngyào, qǐng dàjiā yīdìng yào bǎomì, búnéng gàosu rènhé rén.
examples.english: This project is very important, please everyone must keep it secret and cannot tell anyone.

examples.chinese: 我的姐姐今年开始读本科，她在北京大学学习英语。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de jiějie jīnnián kāishǐ dú běnkē, tā zài Běijīng Dàxué xuéxí Yīngyǔ.
examples.english: My older sister started her undergraduate degree this year, and she's studying English at Peking University.

examples.chinese: 他对这件事的态度很薄，让我感到很失望。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zhè jiàn shì de tàidù hěn báo, ràng wǒ gǎndào hěn shīwàng.
examples.english: His attitude toward this matter was quite indifferent, which made me feel very disappointed.

examples.chinese: 昨天的足球比赛中，我们队以3:2的比分赢了对手。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān de zúqiú bǐsài zhōng, wǒmen duì yǐ 3:2 de bǐfēn yíng le duìshǒu.
examples.english: In yesterday's football match, our team won against the opponent with a score of 3:2.

examples.chinese: 我的哥哥今年从大学毕业了，现在在一家公司工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de gēge jīnnián cóng dàxué bìyè le, xiànzài zài yī jiā gōngsī gōngzuò.
examples.english: My older brother graduated from university this year and now works at a company.

examples.chinese: 他虽然有点笨，但是很努力，所以成绩还不错。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán yǒudiǎn bèn, dànshì hěn nǔlì, suǒyǐ chéngjì háishi búcuò.
examples.english: Although he is a bit dull, he works very hard, so his grades are still pretty good.

examples.chinese: 许多毕业生都在找工作，竞争非常激烈。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō bìyèshēng dōu zài zhǎo gōngzuò, jìngjìng fēicháng jīliè.
examples.english: Many graduates are looking for jobs, and the competition is very fierce.

examples.chinese: 我们应该避免在工作时间玩手机。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi bìmiǎn zài gōngzuò shíjiān wán shǒujī.
examples.english: We should avoid playing with our phones during work hours.

examples.chinese: 为了避免迟到，我每天都早起。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn chídào, wǒ měitiān dōu zǎoqǐ.
examples.english: In order to avoid being late, I wake up early every day.

examples.chinese: 由于天气恶劣，飞机被迫延迟起飞。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì èliè, fēijī bèipò yánchí qǐfēi.
examples.english: Due to bad weather, the airplane was forced to delay its departure.

examples.chinese: 两个学生在课堂上辩论了很久，但还是没有得出结论。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge xuésheng zài kètáng shang biànlùn le hěn jiǔ, dàn háishi méiyǒu déchū jiéluàn.
examples.english: Two students debated for a long time in class, but still didn't reach a conclusion.

examples.chinese: 这个红色的标志表示禁止停车。
examples.pinyin: Zhège hóng sè de biāozhì biǎoshì jìnzhǐ tíngchē.
examples.english: This red sign indicates no parking.

examples.chinese: 我们班被分成了三个编队来完成这个项目。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān bèi fēnchéngle sān ge biānduì lái wánchéng zhège xiàngmù.
examples.english: Our class was divided into three groups to complete this project.

examples.chinese: 她看到礼物时脸上的表情真的很开心。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàndào lǐwù shí liǎnshang de biǎoqíng zhēnde hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Her expression on her face was really happy when she saw the gift.

examples.chinese: 老师在班会上表扬了这次考试成绩最好的学生。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zài bānhuì shang biǎoyáng le zhè cì kǎoshì chéngjì zuì hǎo de xuésheng.
examples.english: The teacher praised the student with the best exam scores at the class meeting.

examples.chinese: 别忘了明天带你的护照来。
examples.pinyin: Bié wàngle míngtiān dài nǐ de hùzhào lái.
examples.english: Don't forget to bring your passport tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 夏天喝冰水很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān hē bīng shuǐ hěn shūfu.
examples.english: It's very refreshing to drink ice water in summer.

examples.chinese: 我把剩菜放在冰箱里，明天可以继续吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ shèngyè fàng zài bīngxiāng lǐ, míngtiān kěyǐ jìxù chī.
examples.english: I put the leftover food in the fridge, and I can continue eating it tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 冬天的时候，山上覆盖了厚厚的冰雪。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān de shíhou, shānshang fùgài le hòuhou de bīngxuě.
examples.english: In winter, the mountain is covered with thick ice and snow.

examples.chinese: 这个士兵在军队里服役了五年。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shìbīng zài jūnduì lǐ fúyì le wǔ nián.
examples.english: This soldier has served in the military for five years.

examples.chinese: 这两家公司决定合并，并开始共同开发新产品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī juédìng hébìng, bìng kāishǐ gòngtóng kāifā xīn chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: The two companies decided to merge and began to jointly develop new products.

examples.chinese: 你迟到几分钟不要紧，重要的是你现在来了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ chídào jǐ fēnzhōng bù yàojǐn, zhònyào de shì nǐ xiànzài lái le.
examples.english: It doesn't matter if you're a few minutes late; what's important is that you're here now.

examples.chinese: 不管天气怎么样，我们都会去公园散步。
examples.pinyin: Búguǎn tiānqì zěnyàng yàng, wǒmen dōu huì qù gōngyuán sǎnbù.
examples.english: No matter what the weather is like, we will still go to the park for a walk.

examples.chinese: 他不在乎别人的看法，只想做自己喜欢的事。
examples.pinyin: Tā búzàihu biérén de kànfǎ, zhǐ xiǎng zuò zìjǐ xǐhuān de shì.
examples.english: He doesn't care about what others think; he only wants to do what he likes.

examples.chinese: 老师让我们帮忙布置教室为明天的活动做准备。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen bāngmang bùzhì jiàoshì wèi míngtiān de huódòng zuò zhǔnbèi.
examples.english: The teacher asked us to help arrange the classroom to prepare for tomorrow's event.

examples.chinese: 你必须现在出发，不然就赶不上火车了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bìxū xiànzài chūfā, bùrán jiù gǎnbushàng huǒchē le.
examples.english: You must leave now, otherwise you'll miss the train.

examples.chinese: 由于地铁在维修，我今天只能步行去上班。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú dìtiě zài wéixiū, wǒ jīntiān zhǐnéng bùxíng qù shàngbān.
examples.english: Since the subway is under maintenance, I can only walk to work today.

examples.chinese: 你学了两年英语才能说得这么好。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xuéle liǎng nián yīngyǔ cái néng shuō de zhème hǎo.
examples.english: Only after studying English for two years were you able to speak this well.

examples.chinese: 我用毛巾擦干了手上的水。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yòng máojīn cāgānle shǒu shang de shuǐ.
examples.english: I used a towel to wipe the water off my hands dry.

examples.chinese: 做这个蛋糕需要什么材料？
examples.pinyin: Zuò zhège dàngāo xūyào shénme cáiliào?
examples.english: What materials do you need to make this cake?

examples.chinese: 他通过多年的辛苦工作积累了不少财富。
examples.pinyin: Tā tōngguò duō nián de xīnkǔ gōngzuò jīlěi le búshǎo cáifù.
examples.english: He accumulated considerable wealth through years of hard work.

examples.chinese: 他在离婚时失去了大部分财产。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài l离hūn shí shīqù le dà bùfen cáichǎn.
examples.english: He lost most of his property during the divorce.

examples.chinese: 在做这个项目之前，我参考了很多资料。
examples.pinyin: Zài zuò zhège xiàngmù zhīqián, wǒ cānkǎole hěnduō zīliào.
examples.english: Before starting this project, I consulted many reference materials.

examples.chinese: 我很高兴能够参与这个项目。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn gāoxìng néng gòu cānyù zhège xiàngmù.
examples.english: I'm very happy to be able to participate in this project.

examples.chinese: 这位记者采访了许多有趣的人物，写成了一篇很受欢迎的报道。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jìzhě cǎifǎngle xǔduō yǒuqù de rénwù, xiěchéngle yī piān hěn shòu huānyíng de bàodào.
examples.english: This reporter covered many interesting people and wrote a very popular article about it.

examples.chinese: 下午我们在操场上踢足球，玩得很开心。
examples.pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǒmen zài cāochǎng shàng tī zúqiú, wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: In the afternoon, we played soccer on the schoolyard and had a lot of fun.

examples.chinese: 这个机器很容易操作，你按照说明书就可以了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jīqì hěn róngyì cāozuò, nǐ ànzhào shuōmíngshū jiù kěyǐ le.
examples.english: This machine is very easy to operate. You just need to follow the instructions.

examples.chinese: 工程师用仪器测量了这座桥的长度。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchéngshī yòng yíqì cèliángle zhè zuò qiào de chángdù.
examples.english: The engineer measured the length of this bridge with instruments.

examples.chinese: 医生用温度计测了一下我的体温。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng yòng wēndù jì cèle yīxià wǒ de tǐwēn.
examples.english: The doctor measured my body temperature with a thermometer.

examples.chinese: 我们需要测试这个新软件，看看是否有问题。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào cèshì zhège xīn ruǎnjiàn, kànkan shìfǒu yǒu wèntí.
examples.english: We need to test this new software to see if there are any problems.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上都喜欢喝一杯茶叶茶，这样能让我精神焕发。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang dōu xǐhuān hē yī bēi cháyè chá, zhèyàng néng ràng wǒ jīngshén huànfā.
examples.english: I like to drink a cup of tea every morning, which helps me feel refreshed and energized.

examples.chinese: 这个产品的质量很好，我很满意。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chǎnpǐn de zhìliàng hěn hǎo, wǒ hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: This product has very good quality, and I am very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 我曾经去过北京，那是一次很难忘的旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ céngnjīng qùguò Běijīng, nàshì yī cì hěn nánwàng de lǚxíng.
examples.english: I once went to Beijing, and it was a very unforgettable trip.

examples.chinese: 这次长途旅行让我感到很疲劳。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chángtú lǚxíng ràng wǒ gǎndào hěn píláo.
examples.english: This long-distance trip made me feel very tired.

examples.chinese: 我买了一张周杰伦的新唱片，音质非常好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎile yī zhāng Zhōu Jiélún de xīn chàngpiàn, yīnzhì fēicháng hǎo.
examples.english: I bought a new record/pressing by Jay Chou, and the sound quality is very good.

examples.chinese: 这是基本的常识，任何人都应该知道。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì jīběn de chángshí, rènhé rén dōu yīnggāi zhīdào.
examples.english: This is basic common sense that anyone should know.

examples.chinese: 老师让我们抄写课文中的重要句子。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen chāoxiě kèwén zhōng de zhònyào jùzi.
examples.english: The teacher had us copy the important sentences from the text.

examples.chinese: 现在很多年轻人都跟着这股潮流买智能手机。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō niánqīngrén dōu跟着zhè gǔ cháoliú mǎi zhìnéng shǒujī.
examples.english: Nowadays, many young people are following this trend and buying smartphones.

examples.chinese: 这道题不要抄别人的答案，要自己思考。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí búyào chāo biérén de dáàn, búyào zìjǐ sīkǎo.
examples.english: Don't copy other people's answers for this question; you should think it through yourself.

examples.chinese: 夏天的时候，海边的潮水每天都会涨退两次。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, hǎibiān de cháoshuǐ měi tiān dōu huì zhǎng tuì liǎng cì.
examples.english: During summer, the tides at the seaside rise and fall twice every day.

examples.chinese: 我们需要彻底改变这个计划，因为原来的方案有太多问题。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào chèdǐ gǎibiàn zhège jìhuà, yīnwèi yuánlái de fāng'àn yǒu tàiduō wèntí.
examples.english: We need to thoroughly change this plan because the original proposal has too many problems.

examples.chinese: 梅雨季节空气很潮湿，衣服放在柜子里容易发霉。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǔ jìjié kōngqì hěn cháoshī, yīfu fàng zài guìzi lǐ róngyì fāméi.
examples.english: During the plum rain season, the air is very damp, and clothes in the closet tend to get moldy.

examples.chinese: 天空沉甸甸的，看起来要下雨了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānkōng chéndiàndiàn de, kàn qǐlái yào xiàyǔ le.
examples.english: The sky looks heavy and gloomy; it seems like it's about to rain.

examples.chinese: 他听到这个消息后就一直沉默，什么话都没有说。
examples.pinyin: Tā tīngdào zhège xiāoxī hòu jiù yīzhí chénmò, shénme huà dōu méiyǒu shuō.
examples.english: After hearing this news, he remained taciturn and didn't say anything.

examples.chinese: 他背着沉重的行李箱走了很久。
examples.pinyin: Tā bēizhe chénzhòng de xínglijīxiāng zǒu le hěn jiǔ.
examples.english: He carried the heavy suitcase and walked for a long time.

examples.chinese: 我哥哥已经成人了，现在在大公司工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēgē yǐjīng chéngrén le, xiànzài zài dà gōngsī gōngzuò.
examples.english: My older brother has become an adult and now works at a large company.

examples.chinese: 他是一个诚实的人，从不说谎。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yī gè chéngshi de rén, cóngbuò shuōhuǎng.
examples.english: He is an honest person who never lies.

examples.chinese: 老师称赞了我这次考试的进步。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī chēngzàn le wǒ zhè cì kǎoshì de jìnbù.
examples.english: The teacher praised my improvement on this exam.

examples.chinese: 作为团队的领导，我需要承担更多的责任。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi tuánduì de lǐngdǎo, wǒ xūyào chéngdān gèngduō de zérènwù.
examples.english: As the team leader, I need to bear more responsibility.

examples.chinese: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú chéngrènle zìjǐ de cuòwù.
examples.english: He finally admitted his mistake.

examples.chinese: 做生意最重要的就是诚信，这样才能赢得顾客的信任。
examples.pinyin: Zuò shēngyì zuì zhòngyào de jiùshi chéngxìn, zhèyàng cái néng yíngde gùkè de xìnrèn.
examples.english: The most important thing in doing business is integrity, only this way can you win customers' trust.

examples.chinese: 我们必须按照公司的程序来处理这个问题。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū ànzhào gōngsī de chéngxù lái chǔlǐ zhège wèntí.
examples.english: We must handle this problem according to the company's procedures.

examples.chinese: 听到这个消息我很吃惊，因为我一点都没有准备。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxī wǒ hěn chījīng, yīnwèi wǒ yīdiǎn dōu méiyǒu zhǔnbèi.
examples.english: I was very startled to hear this news because I was not prepared at all.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的压力太大了，我无法承受。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de yālì tài dà le, wǒ wúfǎ chéngshòu.
examples.english: The pressure from this project is too much; I cannot bear it.

examples.chinese: 这条鱼大约有一尺长。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo yú dàyuē yǒu yī chǐ cháng.
examples.english: This fish is about one chi (roughly one foot) long.

examples.chinese: 昨天我因为堵车迟到了，老板很生气。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ yīnwèi dǔchē chídào le, lǎobǎn hěn shēngqì.
examples.english: I was late yesterday because of traffic, and my boss was very angry.

examples.chinese: 听到警报声，士兵们冲出了营地。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào jǐngbào shēng, shìbīng men chōng chūle yíngdì.
examples.english: Hearing the alarm, the soldiers charged out of the camp.

examples.chinese: 老师让我用尺子在纸上画一条直线。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒ yòng chǐzi zài zhǐ shang huà yī tiáo zhíxiàn.
examples.english: The teacher asked me to draw a straight line on the paper with a ruler.

examples.chinese: 我的手机电池快没电了，我需要找个地方充电。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī diànchí kuài méi diàn le, wǒ xūyào zhǎo ge dìfang chōngdiàn.
examples.english: My phone battery is almost dead, I need to find a place to charge it.

examples.chinese: 我的手机充电器坏了，能借你的用一下吗？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī chōngdiànqì huài le, néng jiè nǐ de yòng yīxià ma?
examples.english: My phone charger is broken. Can I borrow yours for a bit?

examples.chinese: 这件衣服的尺寸太小了，我需要换一个大号的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de chǐcun tài xiǎo le, wǒ xūyào huàn yī ge dà hào de.
examples.english: This clothing's size is too small; I need to change it for a larger one.

examples.chinese: 夏天来了，房间里出现了很多虫子。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān lái le, fángjiān lǐ chūxiàn le hěnduō chóngzi.
examples.english: Summer has arrived, and many insects have appeared in the room.

examples.chinese: 我们有充分的时间来准备这个考试。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu chōngfèn de shíjiān lái zhǔnbèi zhège kǎoshì.
examples.english: We have sufficient time to prepare for this exam.

examples.chinese: 那个人用鞭子抽了他一下。
examples.pinyin: Nàge rén yòng biānzi chōu le tā yīxià.
examples.english: That person lashed him with a whip once.

examples.chinese: 我们公司下周要举行抽奖活动，获胜者可以赢得一台新电脑。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī xiàzhoū yào jǔxíng chōu jiǎng huódòng, huòshènggzhě kěyǐ yíngde yī tái xīn diànnǎo.
examples.english: Our company will hold a drawing event next week, and the winner can win a new computer.

examples.chinese: 中国的茶叶出口到世界各地。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó de chá yè chū kǒu dào shìjiè gè dì.
examples.english: China's tea is exported to all parts of the world.

examples.chinese: 医生告诉他不要在房间里抽烟，因为对家人的健康有害。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng gàosu tā búyào zài fángjiān lǐ chōu yān, yīnwèi duì jiārén de jiànkāng yǒuhài.
examples.english: The doctor told him not to smoke in the room because it's harmful to his family's health.

examples.chinese: 这位老师的教学方法非常出色，学生们都很喜欢他的课。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī de jiàoxué fāngfǎ fēicháng chūsè, xuéshēngmen dōu hěn xǐhuān tā de kè.
examples.english: This teacher's teaching method is outstanding, and all the students really like his class.

examples.chinese: 明天的会议很重要，我们经理一定会出席。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì hěn zhòngyào, wǒmen jīnglǐ yídìng huì chūxí.
examples.english: Tomorrow's meeting is very important, and our manager will definitely attend.

examples.chinese: 目前公司处于发展阶段，需要更多的投资。
examples.pinyin: Mùqián gōngsī chǔyú fāzhǎn jiēduàn, xūyào gèngduō de tóuzī.
examples.english: Currently, the company is in a development stage and needs more investment.

examples.chinese: 这家店正在出售旧家具，价格很便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn zhèngzài chūshòu jiù jiājù, jiàgé hěn piányi.
examples.english: This store is selling used furniture at very cheap prices.

examples.chinese: 这个地方处于城市的中心，交通很方便。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìfang chǔyú chéngshì de zhōngxīn, jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: This place is located in the center of the city, and the transportation is very convenient.

examples.chinese: 冬天来了，我需要穿上厚重的外套才能保暖。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān lái le, wǒ xūyào chuānshang hòuzhòng de wàitào cái néng bǎonuǎn.
examples.english: Winter has arrived, and I need to put on a thick coat to stay warm.

examples.chinese: 早上我打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ dǎkāi chuānghu, ràng xīnxiān kōngqì jìnlái.
examples.english: In the morning, I open the window to let fresh air come in.

examples.chinese: 我在窗台上放了一盆花，每天都能看到它。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài chuāngtái shang fàngle yī pén huā, měi tiān dōu néng kàndào tā.
examples.english: I placed a pot of flowers on the window sill, and I can see it every day.

examples.chinese: 在我们家，每年春节吃饺子是一个传统。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒmen jiā, měi nián chūnjié chī jiǎozi shì yī ge chuántǒng.
examples.english: In our family, eating dumplings every Chinese New Year is a tradition.

examples.chinese: 这个果汁是纯天然的，没有任何添加剂。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guǒzhī shì chún tiānránde, méiyǒu rènhè tiānjiāji.
examples.english: This juice is pure and natural, with no additives.

examples.chinese: 我每天都喝纯净水，对身体很好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān dōu hē chúnjìngshuǐ, duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I drink pure water every day, which is very good for my health.

examples.chinese: 早上我打开窗子，让新鲜空气进来。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ dǎkāi chuāngzi, ràng xīnxiān kōngqì jìnlái.
examples.english: In the morning, I opened the window to let fresh air in.

examples.chinese: 春季是去公园散步的最好时候。
examples.pinyin: Chūnjì shì qù gōngyuán sǎnbù de zuì hǎo shíhou.
examples.english: Springtime is the best time to take a walk in the park.

examples.chinese: 学习一门新语言时，积累词汇是最重要的一步。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí yī mén xīn yǔyán shí, jīlěi cíhuì shì zuì zhòngyào de yī bù.
examples.english: When learning a new language, accumulating vocabulary is the most important step.

examples.chinese: 此外，我们还需要考虑其他的问题。
examples.pinyin: Cǐwài, wǒmen háishi xūyào kǎolǜ qítā de wèntí.
examples.english: Besides this, we still need to consider other issues.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的菜很好吃，此外，服务员也很友好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài hěn hǎochī, cǐwài, fúwùyuán yě hěn yǒuhǎo.
examples.english: The food at this restaurant is delicious, and besides, the waiters are also very friendly.

examples.chinese: 我去过北京三次，每次都很开心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qùguò Běijīng sān cì, měi cì dōu hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: I have been to Beijing three times, and each time was very enjoyable.

examples.chinese: 这部电影的结局很刺激，我看得非常投入。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de jiéjú hěn cìjī, wǒ kàn de fēicháng tóurù.
examples.english: The ending of this movie is very thrilling, and I watched it very attentively.

examples.chinese: 这朵玫瑰花的刺很尖，小心别扎到手。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duǒ méiguihuā de cì hěn jiān, xiǎoxin bié zhā dào shǒu.
examples.english: The thorns on this rose are very sharp, be careful not to prick your hand.

examples.chinese: 自从他搬到了北京以后，从此就再也没有回过家乡。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng tā bān到le běijīng yǐhòu, cóngcǐ jiù zàiyě méiyǒu huíguò jiāxiāng.
examples.english: After he moved to Beijing, he never went back to his hometown from then on.

examples.chinese: 这根绳子太粗了，不好拿。
examples.pinyin: Zhè gēn shéngzi tài cū le, búhǎo názhe.
examples.english: This rope is too thick to hold easily.

examples.chinese: 他很粗心，经常忘记带钥匙。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn cūxīn, jīngcháng wàngjì dài yàoshi.
examples.english: He is very careless and often forgets to bring his keys.

examples.chinese: 这家商店今天有促销活动，所以很多人都来购物。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā shāngdiàn jīntiān yǒu cùxiāo huódòng, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén dōu lái gòuwù.
examples.english: This store has a promotion today, so many people came to shop.

examples.chinese: 政府采取了新的措施来解决交通问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔle le xīn de cuòshī lái jiějué jiāotōng wèntí.
examples.english: The government has taken new measures to solve the traffic problem.

examples.chinese: 这部电影促使我思考人生的意义。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng cùshǐ wǒ sīkǎo rénshēng de yìyì.
examples.english: This movie prompted me to think about the meaning of life.

english: generalized verb of doing with specific meaning determined by its object

examples.chinese: 我每天早上都要打扫房间。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang dōu yào dǎsǎo fángjiān.
examples.english: I have to clean the room every morning.

examples.chinese: 运动可以促进身体健康。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng kěyǐ cùjìn shēntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: Exercise can promote physical health.

examples.chinese: 我找了很久，终于找到了这个问题的答案。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǎole hěnjiǔ, zh终于 zhǎodàole zhège wèntí de dáàn.
examples.english: I looked for a long time and finally found the answer to this question.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上打雷了，我吓得躲在床下面。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang dǎ léi le, wǒ xiàde躲 zài chuáng xiàmiàn.
examples.english: It thundered last night, and I was so scared that I hid under the bed.

examples.chinese: 我们的足球队在比赛中打败了对手，赢得了冠军。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de zúqiú duì zài bǐsài zhōng dǎbài le duìshǒu, yíngdé le guànjūn.
examples.english: Our football team defeated the opponent in the match and won the championship.

examples.chinese: 每个周末，我都会打扫自己的房间。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge zhōumò, wǒ dōu huì dǎsǎo zìjǐ de fángjiān.
examples.english: Every weekend, I clean my own room.

examples.chinese: 这家店今天打折，所有衣服都便宜了20%。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn jīntiān dǎ zhé, suǒyǒu yīfu dōu piányi le 20%.
examples.english: This store is giving a discount today; all clothes are 20% cheaper.

english: to give or have an injection

examples.chinese: 我昨天去医院打针，医生说我需要打三次。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān qù yīyuàn dǎ zhēn, yīshēng shuō wǒ xūyào dǎ sān cì.
examples.english: I went to the hospital yesterday to get an injection, and the doctor said I need to get three shots.

examples.chinese: 大多数学生大多喜欢在周末去公园玩。
examples.pinyin: Dàduōshù xuésheng dàduō xǐhuān zài zhōumò qù gōngyuán wán.
examples.english: Most students generally like to go to the park to play on weekends.

examples.chinese: 我们班级去旅游，坐了一辆大巴车去山里。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bānjí qù lǚyóu, zuòle yī liàng dàbā chē qù shānli.
examples.english: Our class went on a trip and took a big coach bus to the mountains.

examples.chinese: 我的英文老师在语法方面很大方，总是耐心地为我们解答问题。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de yīngwén lǎoshī zài yǔfǎ fāngmiàn hěn dàfang, zǒngshì nàixīn de wèi wǒmen jiědá wèntí.
examples.english: My English teacher is an expert in grammar and always patiently answers our questions.

examples.chinese: 我大哥在北京工作，他是一个很成功的商人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dàgē zài Běijīng gōngzuò, tā shì yīgè hěn chénggōng de shāngrén.
examples.english: My eldest brother works in Beijing, and he is a very successful businessman.

examples.chinese: 这家公司今年进行了大规模的招聘活动。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī jīnnián jìnxíngle dàguīmó de zhāopìn huódòng.
examples.english: This company conducted large-scale recruitment activities this year.

examples.chinese: 明年公司会召开一次重要的大会，讨论新的发展计划。
examples.pinyin: Míngnián gōngsī huì zhàokāi yī cì zhòngyào de dàhuì, tǎolùn xīn de fāzhǎn jìhuà.
examples.english: Next year the company will hold an important conference to discuss new development plans.

examples.chinese: 我大姐现在在北京工作，她很忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dàjiě xiànzài zài Běijīng gōngzuò, tā hěn máng.
examples.english: My big sister is working in Beijing now, and she is very busy.

examples.chinese: 那座大楼是我们公司的新办公室。
examples.pinyin: Nà zuò dàlóu shì wǒmen gōngsī de xīn bàngōngshì.
examples.english: That building is our company's new office.

examples.chinese: 昨天我们全家去餐厅吃饭,大妈穿了一件很漂亮的红色衣服。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒmen quánjiā qù cāntīng chīfàn, dàmā穿le yī jiàn hěn piàoliang de hóngsè yīfu.
examples.english: Yesterday our whole family went to the restaurant to eat, and my uncle's wife wore a very beautiful red dress.

examples.chinese: 这家公司投资了一个大型工厂来生产汽车。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī tóuzīle yīge dàxíng gōngchǎng lái shēngchǎn qìchē.
examples.english: This company invested in a large-scale factory to produce automobiles.

examples.chinese: 我的家人都在大陆，我很想他们。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de jiārén dōu zài dàlù, wǒ hěn xiǎng tāmen.
examples.english: My family members are all on the mainland, and I miss them very much.

examples.chinese: 这部电影很受大众喜爱，已经有很多人去看过了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng hěn shòu dàzhòng xǐ'ài, yǐjīng yǒu hěnduō rén qù kànguò le.
examples.english: This movie is very popular with the masses; many people have already watched it.

examples.chinese: 那个大爷每天都坐在门口，什么事都不做。
examples.pinyin: Nàge dàye měitiān dōu zuòzài ménkǒu, shénme shì dōu búzuò.
examples.english: That arrogant idler sits at the doorway every day and does nothing.

examples.chinese: 今天我生病了，所以我的同事代替我去参加了那个重要的会议。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ shēngbìng le, suǒyǐ wǒ de tóngshì dàitì wǒ qù cānjiāle nàge zhòngyào de huìyì.
examples.english: I got sick today, so my colleague filled in for me and attended that important meeting.

examples.chinese: 我在超市买了一个塑料袋来装购物。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài chāoshì mǎile yī ge塑料袋 lái zhuāng gòuwù.
examples.english: I bought a plastic bag at the supermarket to carry my shopping.

examples.chinese: 这家公司的待遇很好，员工们都很满意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de dàiyù hěn hǎo, yuángōngmen dōu hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: This company's treatment/compensation is very good, and all the employees are satisfied.

examples.chinese: 我每天都戴着我的眼镜去上班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān dōu dàizhe wǒ de yǎnjìng qù shàngbān.
examples.english: I wear my glasses to work every day.

examples.chinese: 他担任公司的市场部经理已经三年了。

examples.chinese: 中国的大城市主要分布在东部沿海地区。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó de dà chéngshì zhǔyào fēnbù zài dōngbù yánhǎi dìqū.
examples.english: The major cities in China are mainly distributed along the eastern coastal regions.

examples.chinese: 他们因为经常吵架，最后决定分手了。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen yīnwèi jīngcháng chǎojià, zuìhòu juéding fēnshǒu le.
examples.english: Because they argued frequently, they finally decided to break up.

examples.chinese: 这个项目分为三个阶段，每个阶段需要两个月。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù fēnwéi sān ge jiēduàn, měi ge jiēduàn xūyào liǎng ge yuè.
examples.english: This project is divided into three stages, and each stage requires two months.

examples.chinese: 这个班级三分之二的学生来自农村。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bānjí sānfēnzhī'èr de xuésheng láizì nóngcūn.
examples.english: Two-thirds of the students in this class come from rural areas.

examples.chinese: 为了实现梦想，我们需要不断地奋斗。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shíxiàn梦xiǎng, wǒmen xūyào búduàn de fèndòu.
examples.english: In order to realize our dreams, we need to keep struggling and working hard.

examples.chinese: 这个建筑师的设计风格很独特，我很喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiànzhùshī de shèjì fēnggé hěn dúté, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
examples.english: This architect's design style is very unique, and I really like it.

examples.chinese: 他想用音乐来分散自己的注意力，不去想那些烦人的事情。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng yòng yīnyuè lái fēnsàn zìjǐ de zhùyìlì, búqù xiǎng nàxiē fánrén de shìqing.
examples.english: He wanted to use music to divert his attention away from those annoying things.

examples.chinese: 这个地方的风景真漂亮，我们应该多来几次。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìfang de fēngjǐng zhēn piàoliang, wǒmen yīnggāi duō lái jǐ cì.
examples.english: The view in this place is really beautiful; we should come here more often.

examples.chinese: 听说新店开业，很多人纷纷赶去购物。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō xīn diàn kāiyè, hěnduō rén fēnfēn gǎnqù gòuwù.
examples.english: I heard the new store is opening, so many people rushed there in droves to shop.

examples.chinese: 他的思想很封闭，不愿意接受新的观点。
examples.pinyin: Tā de sīxiǎng hěn fēngbì, búyuànyì jiēshòu xīn de guāndiǎn.
examples.english: His thinking is very closed-minded and he is unwilling to accept new perspectives.

examples.chinese: 你必须现在就完成作业，否则明天老师会很生气。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bìxū xiànzài jiù wánchéng zuòyè, fǒuzé míngtiān lǎoshī huì hěn shēngqì.
examples.english: You must finish your homework right now, otherwise the teacher will be very angry tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 每个国家都有不同的风俗，我们应该尊重彼此的文化。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu búntóng de fēngsú, wǒmen yīnggāi zunzhòng bǐcǐ de wénhuà.
examples.english: Every country has different mores; we should respect each other's cultures.

examples.chinese: 这对夫妻已经结婚二十年了，他们的感情仍然很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duì fūqī yǐjīng jiéhūn èrshí nián le, tāmen de gǎnqíng仍然 hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This couple has been married for twenty years, and their relationship is still very good.

examples.chinese: 这位夫人是我们公司的董事长。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi fūren shì wǒmen gōngsī de dǒngshìzhǎng.
examples.english: This lady is the chairwoman of our company.

examples.chinese: 这对夫妇已经结婚三十年了，他们的感情一直很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duì fūfù yǐjīng jiéhūn sānshí nián le, tāmen de gǎnqíng yìzhí hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This couple has been married for thirty years, and their relationship has always been good.

examples.chinese: 这个工作的要求符合我的专业背景。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò de yāoqiú fúhé wǒ de zhuānyè bèijǐng.
examples.english: The requirements of this job match my professional background.

examples.chinese: 为了成功，他付出了很多努力和时间。
examples.pinyin: Wèile chénggōng, tā fùchūle hěnduō nǔlì hé shíjiān.
examples.english: In order to succeed, he paid a lot of effort and time.

examples.chinese: 这个符号表示什么意思？
examples.pinyin: Zhège fúhào biǎoshì shénme yìsi?
examples.english: What does this sign mean?

examples.chinese: 我家附近有一家很不错的餐厅，你有时间可以去试试。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu yī jiā hěn búcuò de cāntīng, nǐ yǒu shíjiān kěyǐ qù shìshi.
examples.english: There's a pretty good restaurant near my house. You can try it if you have time.

examples.chinese: 养一个孩子是很大的经济负担。
examples.pinyin: Yǎng yī ge háizi shì hěn dà de jīngjì fùdān.
examples.english: Raising a child is a heavy financial burden.

examples.chinese: 这个文件很重要，我需要复制一份备份。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wénjiàn hěn zhòngyào, wǒ xūyào fùzhì yī fèn bèifèn.
examples.english: This file is important, so I need to duplicate a copy as backup.

examples.chinese: 这个新政策帮助改善了城市的空气质量。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīn zhèngcè bāngzhù gǎishàn le chéngshì de kōngqì zhìliàng.
examples.english: This new policy helped improve the air quality of the city.

examples.chinese: 老师指出了我的错误，我已经改正了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhǐchūle wǒ de cuòwù, wǒ yǐjīng gǎizhèngle.
examples.english: The teacher pointed out my mistake, and I have already corrected it.

examples.chinese: 让我概括一下今天会议的主要内容。
examples.pinyin: Ràng wǒ gàikuò yīxià jīntiān huìyì de zhǔyào nèiróng.
examples.english: Let me summarize the main points of today's meeting.

examples.chinese: 我对中国文化很感兴趣，所以经常去博物馆。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì Zhōngguó wénhuà hěn gǎn xìngqù, suǒyǐ jīngcháng qù bówùguǎn.
examples.english: I'm very interested in Chinese culture, so I often go to museums.

examples.chinese: 今年夏天海边的高潮来得很早，很多游客都想去看。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián xiàtiān hǎibiān de gāocháo lái de hěn zǎo, hěnduō yóukè dōu xiǎng qù kàn.
examples.english: The high tide at the beach this summer came very early, and many tourists wanted to go see it.

examples.chinese: 天气冷了，我给孩子盖上了被子。
examples.pinyin: tiānqì lěngle, wǒ gěi háizi gàishang le bèizi.
examples.english: The weather got cold, so I covered the child with a blanket.

examples.chinese: 这件衣服的高价让很多人都买不起。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de gāojià ràng hěnduō rén dōu mǎi bu qǐ.
examples.english: The high price of this piece of clothing makes it unaffordable for many people.

examples.chinese: 今天天气格外晴朗，我们决定去公园散步。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì géwài qīngláng, wǒmen juéding qù gōngyuán sànbù.
examples.english: The weather is particularly clear today, so we decided to go for a walk in the park.

examples.chinese: 我每个月都坐高铁去北京出差。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge yuè dōu zuò gāotiě qù Běijīng chūchāi.
examples.english: I take the high-speed rail to Beijing for business trips every month.

examples.chinese: 他用高尚的品德赢得了大家的尊敬。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng gāoshàng de pǐndé yíngdéle dàjiā de zūnjìng.
examples.english: He earned everyone's respect with his noble character.

examples.chinese: 我们的房间只隔了一面墙，所以能听到隔壁的声音。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de fángjiān zhǐ géle yī miàn qiáng, suǒyǐ néng tīngdào gébì de shēngyīn.
examples.english: Our rooms are separated by only one wall, so we can hear the sounds from next door.

examples.chinese: 这道墙隔开了两个房间。
examples.pinyin: zhè dào qiáng gékāi le liǎng ge fángjiān.
examples.english: This wall separates two rooms.

examples.chinese: 这个班级里大多数学生都很认真，只有个别学生不太用功。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bānjí lǐ dàduōshù xuésheng dōu hěn rènzhēn, zhǐyǒu gèbié xuésheng búhuì tàiyòng gōngfu.
examples.english: Most students in this class are diligent, only a few students are not very hardworking.

examples.chinese: 这次会议上，各个部门的负责人都发表了自己的意见。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì shang, gègè bùmén de fùzérén dōu fābiǎole zìjǐ de yìjian.
examples.english: At this meeting, the heads of every department all expressed their own opinions.

examples.chinese: 这家公司是从一个小个体户发展起来的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī shì cóng yī gè xiǎo gètǐ hù fāzhǎn qǐlai de.
examples.english: This company developed from a small individual business.

examples.chinese: 这棵树的根很深，已经长了很多年。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kē shù de gēn hěn shēn, yǐjīng zhǎng le hěnduō nián.
examples.english: The roots of this tree are very deep, and it has been growing for many years.

examples.chinese: 根据天气预报，明天会下雨，我们应该带伞。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù tiānqì yùbào, míngtiān huì xiàyǔ, wǒmen yīnggāi dàishàn.
examples.english: Based on the weather forecast, it will rain tomorrow, so we should bring umbrellas.

examples.chinese: 这个建筑工程需要三年才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiànzhù gōngchéng xūyào sān nián cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english: This construction project will take three years to complete.

examples.chinese: 这家工厂主要供应汽车零件给大型企业。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng zhǔyào gōngyìng qìchē língjiàn gěi dàxíng qǐyè.
examples.english: This factory mainly supplies car parts to large enterprises.

examples.chinese: 这个项目一共花了三个月才完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù yīgòng huāle sān ge yuè cái wánchéng.
examples.english: This project took a total of three months to complete.

examples.chinese: 这三个因素共同构成了这个问题的主要原因。
examples.pinyin: zhè sān ge yīnsù gòngtóng gòuchéng le zhège wèntí de zhǔyào yuányīn.
examples.english: These three factors together constitute the main reasons for this problem.

examples.chinese: 这座古城是在公元前200年建造的，已经有两千多年的历史了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔchéng shì zài gōngyuán qián 200 nián jiànzào de, yǐjīng yǒu liǎngqiān duō nián de lìshǐ le.
examples.english: This ancient city was built in 200 BCE and has a history of more than two thousand years.

examples.chinese: 这座桥的构造非常复杂，花了很多年才建成。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo de gòuzào fēicháng fùzá, huāle hěnduō nián cái jiànchéng.
examples.english: The construction of this bridge is very complex, and it took many years to complete.

examples.chinese: 周末我喜欢和朋友一起去商场购物。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ xǐhuān hé péngyou yìqǐ qù shāngchǎng gòuwù.
examples.english: On weekends, I like to go shopping at the mall with friends.

examples.chinese: 我去年购买了一套房子作为投资。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qùnián gòumǎi le yī tào fángzi zuòwéi tóuzī.
examples.english: I invested in a house last year.

examples.chinese: 这只鸡的骨头很硬，小心别咬到牙齿。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī jī de gǔtou hěn yìng, xiǎoxin bié yǎo dào yáchǐ.
examples.english: The bones of this chicken are very hard, be careful not to bite your teeth.

examples.chinese: 这家公司每个月的工资是固定的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī měi ge yuè de gōngzī shì gùdìng de.
examples.english: This company's salary is fixed every month.

examples.chinese: 你怎么了？我觉得你今天有点怪。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme le? Wǒ juéde nǐ jīntiān yǒudiǎn guài.
examples.english: What's wrong with you? I find you a bit strange today.

examples.chinese: 请关上门，外面很冷。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng guānshang mén, wàimiàn hěn lěng.
examples.english: Please shut the door, it's very cold outside.

examples.chinese: 下班前我需要关闭办公室的所有灯。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān qián wǒ xūyào guānbì bàngōngshì de suǒyǒu dēng.
examples.english: Before leaving work, I need to turn off all the lights in the office.

examples.chinese: 官方还没有公布考试成绩，我们再等等吧。
examples.pinyin: Guānfāng háishi méiyǒu gōngbù kǎoshì chéngjī, wǒmen zài děngděng ba.
examples.english: The authorities haven't announced the exam results yet, let's wait a bit longer.

examples.chinese: 他的父亲是一位政府官员，工作很忙。
examples.pinyin: Tā de fùqin shì yī wèi zhèngfǔ guānyuán, gōngzuò hěn máng.
examples.english: His father is a government official with a very busy job.

examples.chinese: 欢迎您光临我们的新餐厅！
examples.pinyin: Huānyíng nín guānglín wǒmen de xīn cāngtīng!
examples.english: Welcome to honor us with your presence at our new restaurant!

examples.chinese: 我想和你谈一下关于周末旅游的计划。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ tán yīxià guānyú zhōumò lǚyóu de jìhuà.
examples.english: I'd like to discuss the weekend travel plans with you.

examples.chinese: 这些书都归你了，你可以随时来拿。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shū dōu guī nǐ le, nǐ kěyǐ suíshí lái náqu取。
examples.english: All these books belong to you now; you can come get them anytime.

examples.chinese: 周末我喜欢和朋友一起逛街，买些衣服和小东西。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ xǐhuān hé péngyou yìqǐ guàngjiē, mǎi xiē yīfu hé xiǎo dōngxi.
examples.english: On weekends, I like to go shopping with friends and buy some clothes and small things.

examples.chinese: 这张光盘里有我最喜欢的音乐。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng guāngpán lǐ yǒu wǒ zuì xǐhuān de yīnyuè.
examples.english: This CD has my favorite music on it.

examples.chinese: 夏天的时候，我喜欢吃冰镇西瓜。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, wǒ xǐhuān chī bīngzhèn xīguā.
examples.english: In summer, I like to eat chilled watermelon.

examples.chinese: 每个人的身体都有自己的规律，早睡早起对健康很重要。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén de shēntǐ dōu yǒu zìjǐ de guīlǜ, zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ duì jiànkāng hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: Everyone's body has its own patterns; going to bed and waking up early is very important for health.

examples.chinese: 每个游戏都有自己的规则，我们必须遵守。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge yóuxì dōu yǒu zìjǐ de guīzé, wǒmen bìxū zūnshǒu.
examples.english: Every game has its own rules, and we must follow them.

examples.chinese: 这棵苹果树今年结了很多果实。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kē píngguǒ shù jīnnián jiéle hěnduō guǒshí.
examples.english: This apple tree produced a lot of fruit this year.

examples.chinese: 这个海滩的海水很清澈，特别适合游泳。
examples.pinyin: Zhège hǎitān de hǎishuǐ hěn qīngchè, tèbié shìhéyú yóuyǒng.
examples.english: The seawater at this beach is very clear and especially suitable for swimming.

examples.chinese: 你这样做太过分了，我真的很生气。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhèyàng zuò tài guòfèn le, wǒ zhēnde hěn shēngqì.
examples.english: What you did was too excessive; I'm really angry.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的海鲜特别新鲜，我很喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de hǎixiān tèbié xīnxiān, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
examples.english: The seafood at this restaurant is especially fresh, and I really like it.

examples.chinese: 这个糖果含有很多糖分，吃太多对牙齿不好。
examples.pinyin: Zhège tángguǒ hányǒu hěnduō tángfèn, chī tàiduō duì yáchǐ búhǎo.
examples.english: This candy contains a lot of sugar, and eating too much is bad for your teeth.

examples.chinese: 这家公司的规模很大，在全国有几百家分店。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de guīmó hěn dà, zài quánguó yǒu jǐ bǎi jiā fēndiàn.
examples.english: This company has a large scale with hundreds of branches across the country.

examples.chinese: 这种果汁的糖含量太高了，我不太喜欢喝。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng guǒzhī de táng hánliàng tài gāo le, wǒ bú太 xǐhuān hē.
examples.english: The sugar content in this kind of juice is too high, I don't really like drinking it.

examples.chinese: 这个果汁含有很多维生素，对身体很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guǒzhī hányǒu hěnduō wéishēngsù, duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This fruit juice contains a lot of vitamins, which is very good for the body.

examples.chinese: 这句话的含义不太明显，我需要问问老师才能理解。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jù huà de hányì búhuò míngxiǎn, wǒ xūyào wènwen lǎoshī cáinéng lǐjiě.
examples.english: The meaning of this sentence is not very clear; I need to ask the teacher to understand it.

examples.chinese: 今年寒假我打算和家人一起去南方旅游。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián hánjià wǒ dǎsuàn hé jiārén yìqǐ qù nánfāng lǚyóu.
examples.english: This winter vacation, I plan to travel to the south with my family.

examples.chinese: 冬天的寒冷让我不想出门。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān de hánlěng ràng wǒ búxiǎng chūmén.
examples.english: The coldness of winter makes me not want to go out.

examples.chinese: 我的航班明天早上八点起飞，所以今天晚上要早点睡觉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de hángbān míngtiān zǎoshang bā diǎn qǐfēi, suǒyǐ jīntiān wǎnshang yào zǎodiǎn shuìjiào.
examples.english: My flight takes off at eight o'clock tomorrow morning, so I need to go to bed early tonight.

examples.chinese: 我叔叔在一家航空公司工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shūshu zài yī jiā hángkōng gōngsī gōngzuò.
examples.english: My uncle works at an airline company.

examples.chinese: 这块玻璃只有两毫米厚，很容易破。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài bōli zhǐyǒu liǎng háomǐ hòu, hěn róngyì pò.
examples.english: This piece of glass is only two millimeters thick and breaks easily.

examples.chinese: 他在房地产行业工作了十年，现在是一个很成功的经理。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài fángdìchǎn hángyè gōngzuòle shí nián, xiànzài shì yīge hěn chénggōng de jīnglǐ.
examples.english: He has worked in the real estate industry for ten years and is now a very successful manager.

examples.chinese: 他和张明是多年的好友，经常一起去旅游。
examples.pinyin: Tā hé Zhāng Míng shì duō nián de hǎoyǒu, jīngcháng yìqǐ qù lǚyóu.
examples.english: He and Zhang Ming are longtime close friends who often travel together.

examples.chinese: 这瓶药水每次只需要喝10毫升。
examples.pinyin: Zhè píng yàoshuǐ měi cì zhǐ xūyào hē shí háoshēng.
examples.english: This bottle of medicine only requires drinking 10 milliliters each time.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的菜很好吃，我们经常去那里吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài hěn hǎochī, wǒmen jīngcháng qù nàlǐ chīfàn.
examples.english: The food at this restaurant is very good, so we often go there to eat.

examples.chinese: 你能告诉我你的电话号码吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng gàosu wǒ nǐ de diànhuà hàomǎ ma?
examples.english: Can you tell me your phone number?

examples.english: This office is 50 square meters, which is enough for our team to use.

examples.chinese: 听了医生的解释后，她的心情慢慢变得平静了。

examples.english: After listening to the doctor's explanation, her mood gradually became calm.

examples.english: The most imminent problem right now is that we need to find a solution.

examples.chinese: 这辆车开得很平稳，坐在里面很舒服。

examples.english: This car drives very smoothly, and it's very comfortable to sit in.

examples.chinese: 他的妻子是一位教师，她在一所小学教英语。

examples.english: His wife is a teacher; she teaches English at a primary school.

examples.chinese: 这家公司因为管理不好，最后破产了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yīnwèi guǎnlǐ bù hǎo, zuìhòu pòchǎn le.
examples.english: This company went bankrupt in the end because of poor management.

examples.chinese: 期末考试快到了，我需要开始复习功课。
examples.pinyin: Qīmò kǎoshì kuài dào le, wǒ xūyào kāishǐ fùxí gōngkè.
examples.english: The end-of-term exam is coming soon, so I need to start reviewing my lessons.

examples.chinese: 我一直期待暑假的到来，这样就可以去旅游了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yīzhí qīdài shǔjià de dàolái, zhèyàng jiù kěyǐ qù lǚyóu le.
examples.english: I've been looking forward to the summer vacation arrival so that I can go traveling.

examples.chinese: 暑假期间，我们一家人去了海边旅游。
examples.pinyin: Shǔjiǎ qījiān, wǒmen yī jiā rén qù le hǎibiān lǚyóu.
examples.english: During the summer vacation, our family went to the beach for a trip.

examples.chinese: 下周是期中考试，我需要好好复习一下。
examples.pinyin: Xiàzhōu shì qīzhōng kǎoshì, wǒ xūyào hǎohāo fùxí yīxià.
examples.english: Next week is the midterm exam, and I need to study hard.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的期限是三个月，我们必须按时完成。

examples.english: The time limit for this project is three months, and we must complete it on time.

examples.chinese: 这家企业在市场上有很强的竞争力。

examples.english: This enterprise has strong competitiveness in the market.

examples.chinese: 小孩子们在公园里放气球，开心地跑来跑去。

examples.english: The little children were flying balloons in the park, running back and forth happily.

examples.chinese: 这个班有三十个学生,其中十个是男生,其余的都是女生。

examples.english: This class has thirty students, ten of whom are boys, and the rest are all girls.

examples.chinese: 夏天喝冰汽水比喝热茶舒服多了。

examples.english: Drinking ice-cold soda in summer is much more comfortable than drinking hot tea.

examples.chinese: 医生检查了他的各个器官，确保身体很健康。

examples.english: The doctor examined all of his organs to make sure his body was very healthy.

examples.chinese: 这个工作前途很好，我决定接受这个机会。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò qiántú hěn hǎo, wǒ juédìng jiēshòu zhège jīhuì.
examples.english: This job has great prospects, so I decided to accept this opportunity.

examples.chinese: 这辆车很费汽油，我每个月都要花很多钱加油。

examples.english: This car uses a lot of gasoline, and I have to spend a lot of money on gas every month.

examples.chinese: 这条河很浅，小孩子可以在里面玩水。

examples.english: This river is very shallow, so children can play in the water.

examples.chinese: 前头有个公园，我们可以在那里散步。

examples.english: There's a park in front, we can take a walk there.

examples.chinese: 这家咖啡馆的巧克力蛋糕特别好吃，我每周都会来买一个。

examples.english: The chocolate cake at this café is especially delicious, and I buy one every week.

examples.chinese: 他们两个是亲密的朋友，经常一起出去玩。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen liǎng ge shì qīnmì de péngyou, jīngcháng yìqǐ chūqu wán.
examples.english: The two of them are close friends and often go out to play together.

examples.chinese: 亲爱的朋友，我想和你分享这个好消息。

examples.english: Dear friend, I want to share this good news with you.

examples.chinese: 妈妈正在厨房里切菜，准备做晚餐。

examples.english: Mom is cutting vegetables in the kitchen to prepare dinner.

examples.chinese: 我们应该在青春的时候努力学习，为将来做准备。

examples.english: We should study hard during our youth and prepare for the future.

examples.chinese: 这个周末我没有太多作业，感觉很轻松。

examples.english: This weekend I don't have much homework, so I feel very relaxed.

examples.chinese: 这个问题不能轻易解决，需要更多时间来研究。

examples.english: This problem cannot be easily solved; it requires more time to research.

examples.chinese: 他喝了一杯咖啡以后，头脑变得清醒了。

examples.english: After he drank a cup of coffee, his mind became clear and alert.

examples.chinese: 电影里那个情景让我想起了童年的回忆。

examples.english: That scene in the movie reminded me of my childhood memories.

examples.chinese: 他穷尽了所有的办法来解决这个问题。

examples.english: He exhausted all possible methods to solve this problem.

examples.chinese: 这个城市有很多穷人需要帮助。

examples.english: There are many poor people in this city who need help.

examples.chinese: 现在的趋势是越来越多的人喜欢在网上购物。

examples.english: The current trend is that more and more people like to shop online.

examples.chinese: 秋季是最适合旅游的季节，天气凉爽，风景也很美。
examples.pinyin: Qiūjì shì zuì shìhé lǚyóu de jìjié, tiānqì liánghuǎng, fēngjǐng yě hěn měi.
examples.english: Autumn is the best season for traveling, with cool weather and beautiful scenery.

examples.chinese: 我在朋友圈里分享了这张照片。

examples.english: I shared this photo in my circle of friends.

examples.english: Please confirm whether your email address is correct.

examples.english: This car needs fuel. Let's go to the gas station.

examples.english: This job is very interesting; however, the salary is not very high.

examples.english: The big fire in the forest burned for three days and three nights.

examples.english: He is very enthusiastic and always actively helps his classmates in the class.

examples.english: The commercial street is very lively on weekends, full of people shopping everywhere.

examples.english: The calendar on my desk has already turned to December.

examples.english: Nowadays, many young people like to shop online.

examples.chinese: 我每天都写日记，记录自己的想法和经历。

examples.english: I write in my diary every day to record my thoughts and experiences.

examples.chinese: 电影散场后,观众们陆续离开了电影院。

examples.english: After the movie ended, the audience gradually left the cinema.

examples.english: Mom sweeps and mops the floor every day.

examples.english: The color of this piece of clothing suits you very well.

examples.english: It's raining, I forgot to bring an umbrella, so I had to run back home.

examples.chinese: 这幅画的色彩很鲜艳，让人看了感到很开心。

examples.english: The hues in this painting are very vibrant, making people feel happy when they look at it.

examples.english: I accidentally strained my lower back while playing football yesterday, and it still hurts a bit now.

examples.chinese: 昨天的暴风雨中，我看到了一道闪电划过天空。

examples.english: During yesterday's thunderstorm, I saw a flash of lightning streak across the sky.

examples.english: Let's air the clothes on the balcony.

examples.english: Looking at your phone for a long time will harm your eyes.

examples.chinese: 我的英语老师善于用有趣的故事来教我们语法。

examples.english: Last month I went to Beijing on a business trip and stayed there for a week.

examples.chinese: 我很喜欢在秋天去公园里赏枫叶。

examples.english: I really like going to the park to admire the maple leaves in autumn.

examples.chinese: 医生今天下午会上门给我奶奶检查身体。

examples.english: The doctor will drop by this afternoon to check on my grandmother's health.

examples.english: I'm tired and want to go upstairs to rest for a while.

examples.chinese: 我妈妈用烤箱烧了一条鱼，味道很好。

examples.english: My mom broiled a fish in the oven, and it tasted great.

examples.chinese: 我需要设置一个新的密码来保护我的账户。

examples.english: I need to set a new password to protect my account.

examples.chinese: 我想申请一个新的银行卡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng shēnqǐng yīgè xīn de yínháng kǎ.
examples.english: I want to apply for a new bank card.

examples.chinese: 她坚持运动，保持了很好的身材。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiānchí yùndòng, bǎochíle hěn hǎo de shēncái.
examples.english: She persists in exercising and maintains a good figure.

examples.chinese: 这个公园的设施很完善，有很多运动器材。

examples.english: The facilities in this park are very complete, with lots of exercise equipment.

examples.chinese: 他们之间有深厚的友谊，已经是好朋友十多年了。

examples.chinese: 他的身份是一名教师，所以他很受学生们的尊重。

examples.english: There are many mysterious legends in this ancient temple.

examples.english: His opinion is the opposite of mine, but we are still good friends.

examples.chinese: 我在行李箱里放了一些衣服和书。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài xínglǐ xiāng lǐ fàngle yīxiē yīfu hé shū.
examples.english: I put some clothes and books in the suitcase.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xiāngzi lǐ zhuāngmǎn le yīfu hé shū.
examples.english: My suitcase is full of clothes and books.

examples.chinese: 我很想念我的家人，特别是在假期的时候。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiǎngniàn wǒ de jiārén, tèbié shì zài jiàqī de shíhou.
examples.english: I miss my family very much, especially during holidays.

examples.chinese: 我很难想象没有手机的生活会是什么样子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn nán xiǎngxiàng méiyǒu shǒujī de shēnghuó huì shì shénme yàngzi.
examples.english: I find it hard to imagine what life would be like without a phone.

examples.chinese: 我们公司今年有一个很重要的项目要完成。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī jīnnián yǒu yīgè hěn zhòngyào de xiàngmù yào wánchéng.
examples.english: Our company has a very important project to complete this year.

examples.chinese: 这个项目需要三个月才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào sān ge yuè cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english: This project needs three months to be completed.

examples.chinese: 我找到了一张童年的相片，看起来我那时候很可爱。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǎodàole yī zhāng tóngniánde xiàngpiàn, kàn qǐlai wǒ nàshíhou hěn kěài.
examples.english: I found a photo from my childhood, and I looked very cute back then.

examples.chinese: 这家店的销售额每个月都在增加。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de xiāoshòué měi ge yuè dōu zài zēngjiā.
examples.english: This store's sales revenue increases every month.

examples.chinese: 吃太饱了，我需要休息一会儿来消化食物。
examples.pinyin: Chī tài bǎo le, wǒ xūyào xiūxi yīhuǐr lái xiāohuà shíwù.
examples.english: I ate too much and need to rest for a while to digest the food.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的小吃很有名，很多人都喜欢来这里吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de xiǎochī hěn yǒumíng, hěnduō rén dōu xǐhuān lái zhèlǐ chī.
examples.english: This restaurant's snacks are very famous, and many people like coming here to eat.

examples.chinese: 那个小伙子在咖啡店里工作，他很热情。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohuǒzi zài kāfēidiàn lǐ gōngzuò, tā hěn règíng.
examples.english: That young man works at the coffee shop, and he is very enthusiastic.

examples.chinese: 这个小型望远镜很适合旅游时携带。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎoxíng wàngyuǎnjìng hěn shìy合 lǚyóu shí携dài.
examples.english: This small spyglass is very suitable for carrying while traveling.

examples.chinese: 这个新软件大大提高了我们的工作效率。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīn ruǎnjiàn dàdà tíigāole wǒmen de gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
examples.english: This new software greatly improved our work efficiency.

examples.chinese: 我买了一些水果和蔬菜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le yīxiē shuǐguǒ hé shūcài.
examples.english: I bought some fruits and vegetables.

examples.chinese: 他在比赛前做了一些心理建设，这样才能放松。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bǐsài qián zuòle yīxiē xīnlǐ jiànshè, zhèyàng cáinéng fàngsōng.
examples.english: He did some mental preparation before the competition so he could relax.

examples.chinese: 婚礼那天,新郎穿着一身黑色的西装,看起来非常帅气。
examples.pinyin: Hūnlǐ nà tiān, xīnláng chuānzhe yī shēn hēisè de xīzhuāng, kàn qǐlái fēicháng shuàiqi.
examples.english: On the wedding day, the groom wore a black suit and looked very handsome.

examples.chinese: 今天的新娘穿着一件漂亮的白色婚纱。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de xīnniáng穿着 yī jiàn piàoliang de báisè hūny纱。
examples.english: Today's bride is wearing a beautiful white wedding dress.

examples.chinese: 这家超市的蔬菜很新鲜，我经常在这里买菜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshì de shūcài hěn xīnxiān, wǒ jīngcháng zài zhèlǐ mǎi cài.
examples.english: The vegetables at this supermarket are very fresh, and I often buy groceries here.

examples.chinese: 这家公司推出了一种新型的手机，很受年轻人欢迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī tuīchūle yī zhǒng xīnxíng de shǒujī, hěn shòu niánqīngrén huānyíng.
examples.english: This company launched a new type of mobile phone that is very popular with young people.

examples.chinese: 听说明天要去旅游，孩子们都很兴奋，一晚上都睡不着。
examples.pinyin: Tīnggshuō míngtiān yào qù lǚyóu, háizimen dōu hěn xīngfèn, yī wǎnshang dōu shuì búzháo.
examples.english: Hearing that they're going on a trip tomorrow, the children are all excited and can't sleep all night.

examples.chinese: 很难用语言形容那个美丽的景色。
examples.pinyin: Hěn nán yòng yǔyán xíngróng nàge měilì de jǐngsè.
examples.english: It's hard to characterize that beautiful scenery with words.

examples.chinese: 现在的形势很复杂，我们需要小心应对。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de xíngshì hěn fùzá, wǒmen xūyào xiǎoxin yìngduì.
examples.english: The current circumstances are very complicated, so we need to handle them carefully.

examples.chinese: 这款手机的设计风格很新颖，属于最新型号。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn shǒujī de shèjì fēnggé hěn xīnyǐng, shǔyú zuì xīn xíng hào.
examples.english: This phone model has a very novel design style and belongs to the latest type.

examples.chinese: 这台电脑的型号是最新的，性能很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo de xínghào shì zuì xīn de, xìngnéng hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This computer's model is the latest one, and its performance is very good.

examples.chinese: 早上我被闹钟吵醒了。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ bèi nàozhōng chǎoxǐng le.
examples.english: I was woken up by the alarm clock this morning.

examples.chinese: 我对学习中文很有兴趣，所以每天都坚持练习。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì xuéxí zhōngwén hěn yǒu xìngqù, suǒyǐ měi tiān dōu jiānchíyuǎn liànxí.
examples.english: I have a great interest in learning Chinese, so I practice every day.

examples.chinese: 这个问题的性质很复杂，我们需要仔细分析。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí de xìngzhì hěn fùzá, wǒmen xūyào zǐxì fēnxī.
examples.english: The nature of this problem is very complex, and we need to analyze it carefully.

examples.chinese: 他在胸部受了一点伤，医生说不严重。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài xiōngbù shòu le yīdiǎn shāng, yīshēng shuō bù yánzhòng.
examples.english: He was slightly injured on his chest, and the doctor said it's not serious.

examples.chinese: 我和我的兄弟经常一起踢足球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé wǒ de xiōngdi jīngcháng yīqǐ tī zúqiú.
examples.english: My brothers and I often play football together.

examples.chinese: 我的自行车坏了，需要去修理店修理一下。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de zìxíngchē huài le, xūyào qù xiūlǐ diàn xiūlǐ yīxià.
examples.english: My bicycle is broken and needs to be repaired at the repair shop.

examples.chinese: 你需要好好想想，然后做出正确的选择。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xūyào hǎohāo xiǎngxiang, ránhòu zuòchū zhèngquè de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: You need to think carefully, and then make the right choice.

examples.chinese: 这个学年我们要学习更多的数学知识。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xuénián wǒmen yào xuéxí gèngduō de shùxué zhīshi.
examples.english: This academic year we need to learn more mathematical knowledge.

examples.chinese: 这门课程只给2个学分，但是特别有意思。
examples.pinyin: Zhè mén kèchéng zhǐ gěi 2 ge xuéfēn, dànshì tèbié yǒu yìsi.
examples.english: This course only gives 2 credits, but it's particularly interesting.

examples.chinese: 这个课程总共有120学时，需要一个学期才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhège kèchéng zǒnggòng yǒu 120 xuéshí, xūyào yī ge xuéqī cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english: This course has a total of 120 class hours and takes one semester to complete.

examples.chinese: 他虽然没有上过大学，但是通过读书积累了很多学问。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán méiyǒu shàngguo dàxué, dànshì tōngguò dúshū jīlěi le hěnduō xuéwen.
examples.english: Although he never went to university, he accumulated a lot of learning through reading.

examples.chinese: 他在学术研究方面取得了很大的成就。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài xuéshù yánjiū fāngmiàn qǔdéle hěn dà de chéngjiù.
examples.english: He has achieved great success in academic research.

examples.chinese: 警察正在寻找那个失踪的小男孩。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zhèngzài xúnzhǎo nàge shīzōng de xiǎo nánháizi.
examples.english: The police are searching for the missing little boy.

examples.chinese: 这件象牙雕刻品是从非洲进口的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn xiàngyá diāokè pǐn shì cóng Fēizhōu jìnkǒu de.
examples.english: This ivory carving is imported from Africa.

examples.chinese: 听到铃声后，学生们迅速回到了教室。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào língshēng hòu, xuéshēngmen xùnsù huídàole jiàoshì.
examples.english: After hearing the bell, the students quickly returned to the classroom.

examples.chinese: 今年的亚运会在杭州举行，很多运动员都想参加。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de yàyùnhuì zài Hángzhōu jǔxíng, hěnduō yùndòngyuán dōu xiǎng cānjiā.
examples.english: This year's Asian Games is being held in Hangzhou, and many athletes want to participate.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上都要用牙刷刷牙，这样才能保持牙齿健康。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang dōu yào yòng yáshuā shuā yá, zhèyàng cái néng bǎo chí yá chǐ jiàn kāng.
examples.english: I brush my teeth with a toothbrush every morning to keep my teeth healthy.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ lái la ya, wǒmen dōu zài děng nǐ ne.
examples.english: Oh, you're here! We've all been waiting for you.

examples.chinese: 由于天气不好，会议延长了两个小时。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì búhǎo, huìyì yáncháng le liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Due to bad weather, the meeting was extended by two hours.

examples.chinese: 由于天气不好，会议延期到了下周。

examples.english: Due to bad weather, the meeting was delayed until next week.

examples.chinese: 学校严格要求学生按时完成作业。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào yángé yāoqiú xuésheng ànshí wánchéng zuòyè.
examples.english: The school strictly requires students to complete their homework on time.

examples.chinese: 我的朋友叫严涛，他是一个很严肃的人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyou jiào Yán Tāo, tā shì yīgè hěn yánsuà de rén.
examples.english: My friend is called Yan Tao, and he is a very serious person.

examples.chinese: 这个传统已经延续了很多年，我们希望能够继续保持下去。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chuántǒng yǐjīng yánxù le hěn duō nián, wǒmen xīwàng néng gòu jìxù bǎochí xiàqù.
examples.english: This tradition has continued for many years, and we hope to keep maintaining it.

examples.chinese: 他最近的工作压力很严重，所以需要好好休息。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn de gōngzuò yālì hěn yánzhòng, suǒyǐ xūyào hǎohāo xiūxi.
examples.english: He has been under serious work pressure recently, so he needs to rest well.

examples.chinese: 我们小组正在研究如何改进这个产品。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiǎozǔ zhèngzài yánjiū rúhé gǎijìn zhège chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: Our team is currently studying how to improve this product.

examples.chinese: 我的哥哥是一名研究生，他在大学里学习计算机。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de gēge shì yī míng yánjiūshēng, tā zài dàxué lǐ xuéxí jìsuànjī.
examples.english: My older brother is a graduate student who studies computer science at university.

examples.chinese: 这家公司正在研制一种新的智能手机。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhèngzài yánzhì yī zhǒng xīn de zhìnéng shǒujī.
examples.english: This company is currently manufacturing a new type of smartphone.

examples.chinese: 这道菜需要加一点盐，味道会更好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài xūyào jiā yīdiǎn yán, wèidào huì gèng hǎo.
examples.english: This dish needs a little salt added, and it will taste better.

examples.chinese: 那个学生是个眼镜，考试的时候经常作弊。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xuésheng shì ge yǎnjìng, kǎoshì de shíhou jīngcháng zuòbì.
examples.english: That student is a cheater; he often cheats on exams.

examples.chinese: 看到那部电影的结局，她忍不住流下了眼泪。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào nà bù diànyǐng de jiéjú, tā rěnbuzhù liúxiàle yǎnlèi.
examples.english: After seeing the ending of that movie, she couldn't help but shed tears.

examples.chinese: 明天下午我要在学校里做一个关于环保的演讲。
examples.pinyin: míngtiān xiàwǔ wǒ yào zài xuéxiào lǐ zuò yīgè guānyú huánbǎo de yǎnjiǎng。
examples.english: Tomorrow afternoon I'm going to give a lecture about environmental protection at school.

examples.chinese: 我喜欢在阳台上喝咖啡，看城市的风景。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zài yángtái shang hēkāfēi, kàn chéngshì de fēngjǐng.
examples.english: I like to drink coffee on the veranda and enjoy the city view.

examples.chinese: 这条裤子在腰的地方有点紧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo kuzi zài yāo de dìfang yǒudiǎn jǐn.
examples.english: These pants are a bit tight at the waist.

examples.chinese: 在他眼里，没有什么比家人更重要。
examples.pinyin: Zài tā yǎnli, méiyǒu shénme bǐ jiārén gèng zhòngyào.
examples.english: In his eyes, nothing is more important than family.

examples.chinese: 坚持运动可以养成健康的生活习惯。
examples.pinyin: Jiānchíyùndòng kěyǐ yǎngchéng jiànkāng de shēnghuó xíguàn.
examples.english: Exercising consistently can cultivate healthy living habits.

examples.chinese: 医生给我开了一些药物来治疗感冒。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng gěi wǒ kāile yīxiē yàowù lái zhìliáo gǎnmào.
examples.english: The doctor prescribed some medicine for me to treat my cold.

examples.chinese: 这棵大树在风中摇动，发出沙沙的声音。
examples.pinyin: Zhè k棵 dà shù zài fēng zhōng yáo dòng, fā chū shā shā de shēng yīn.
examples.english: The big tree swayed in the wind, making a rustling sound.

examples.chinese: 我要去超市买点东西，你要不要一起去？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù chāoshìchǎng mǎi diǎn dōngxi, nǐ yào buyào yìqǐ qù?
examples.english: I want to go to the supermarket to buy some things. Do you want to go with me?

examples.chinese: 他业余时间喜欢弹吉他。
examples.pinyin: Tā yèyú shíjiān xǐhuān tán jítā.
examples.english: In his spare time, he likes to play guitar.

examples.chinese: 这家医院的医疗设备很先进，很多患者都来这里治疗。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de yīliáo shèbèi hěn xiāngjìn, hěnduō huànzhě dōu lái zhèlǐ zhìliáo.
examples.english: This hospital's medical equipment is very advanced, and many patients come here for treatment.

examples.chinese: 我的哥哥在大学里学习医学，他想成为一名医生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de gēge zài dàxué lǐ xuéxí yīxué, tā xiǎng chéngwéi yī míng yīshēng.
examples.english: My older brother is studying medicine at university, and he wants to become a doctor.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的成功依靠全体员工的努力。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de chénggōng yīkào quántǐ yuángōng de nǔlì.
examples.english: The success of this project relies on the efforts of all employees.

examples.chinese: 公司规定，所有员工迟到一律扣工资。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī guīdìng, suǒyǒu yuángōng chídào yīlǜ kòu gōngzī.
examples.english: The company has a rule that all employees who are late will equally have their salary deducted.

examples.chinese: 我们的意见一致，都认为这个计划很好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de yìjiàn yīzhì, dōu rènwéi zhège jìhuà hěn hǎo.
examples.english: Our opinions are in agreement; we all think this plan is good.

examples.chinese: 秋天到了，树上的叶子都变红了。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān dào le, shù shang de yèzi dōu biàn hóng le.
examples.english: Autumn has arrived, and all the leaves on the trees have turned red.

examples.chinese: 虽然下雨了，但孩子们依然在公园里开心地玩耍。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán xiàyǔ le, dàn háizi men yīrán zài gōngyuán lǐ kāixīn de wánshuǎ.
examples.english: Although it rained, the children were still playing happily in the park.

examples.chinese: 他一再强调这个项目很重要，我们必须认真对待。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīzài qiángdiào zhège xiàngmù hěn zhòngyào, wǒmen bìxū rènzhēn duìdài.
examples.english: He repeatedly emphasized that this project is very important, and we must take it seriously.

examples.chinese: 请不要移动这些盒子，它们等会儿要用。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng búyào yídòng zhèxiē hézibox, tāmen děnghuǐr yào yòng.
examples.english: Please don't move these boxes; we'll need them later.

examples.chinese: 我们决定把办公室移到新的楼里。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen juédìng bǎ bàngōngshì yí dào xīn de lóu lǐ.
examples.english: We decided to move the office to a new building.

examples.chinese: 这座古城是我们国家宝贵的文化遗产，我们应该好好保护它。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔchéng shì wǒmen guójiā báoguì de wénhuà yíchǎn, wǒmen yīnggāi hǎohāo bǎohù tā.
examples.english: This ancient city is a precious cultural heritage of our country, and we should protect it well.

examples.chinese: 他的父母是从农村移民到城市的。
examples.pinyin: Tā de fùmǔ shì cóng nóngcūn yímín dào chéngshì de.
examples.english: His parents emigrated from the countryside to the city.

examples.chinese: 我的蓝眼睛是从我爸爸那里遗传来的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de lán yǎnjing shì cóng wǒ bàba nàlǐ yíchuán lái de.
examples.english: My blue eyes were inherited from my father.

examples.chinese: 我对他的解释有一些疑问，想听听他的进一步说明。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì tā de jiěshì yǒu yīxiē yíwèn, xiǎng tīngtīng tā de jìnyībù shuōmíng.
examples.english: I have some questions about his explanation and would like to hear further clarification from him.

examples.chinese: 我喜欢吃米饭、面条以及各种蔬菜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān chī mǐfàn, miàntiáo yǐjí gèzhǒng shūcài.

examples.chinese: 音乐会上，指挥家在舞台上指挥乐队演奏了一首美妙的交响曲。
