examples.english: At the concert, the conductor conducted the orchestra on stage and performed a beautiful symphony.

examples.chinese: 这个包的质量很好，用了两年还是新的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bāo de zhìliàng hěn hǎo, yòngle liǎng nián háishi xīn de.
examples.english: This bag is of good quality; it still looks new after two years of use.

examples.chinese: 他在大学里治学很认真，每天都在图书馆学习。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài dàxué lǐ zhìxué hěn rènzhēn, měi tiān dōu zài túshūguǎn xuéxí.
examples.english: He studies very seriously at university and spends every day in the library.

examples.chinese: 医生给我开了一些药物来治疗我的感冒。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng gěi wǒ kāile yīxiē yàowù lái zhìliáo wǒ de gǎnmào.
examples.english: The doctor prescribed me some medicine to treat my cold.

examples.chinese: 这个游戏可以帮助孩子们提高智力。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yóuxì kěyǐ bāngzhù háizimen tígāo zhìlì.
examples.english: This game can help children improve their intelligence.

examples.chinese: 这个智能手机的功能很强大。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhìnéng shǒujī de gōngnéng hěn qiángdà.
examples.english: This smartphone has very powerful functions.

examples.chinese: 我找了一个房产中介帮我租房子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǎole yīgè fangchǎn zhōngjiè bāng wǒ zū fángzi.
examples.english: I found a real estate agent to help me rent an apartment.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅有很多种类的菜，我不知道吃什么好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng yǒu hěnduō zhǒnglèi de cài, wǒ búzhīdào chī shénme hǎo.
examples.english: This restaurant has many types of dishes, and I don't know what to eat.

examples.chinese: 我没想到自己会中奖，真是太幸运了！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi xiǎngdào zìjǐ huì zhòng jiǎng, zhēnshi tài xìngyùn le!
examples.english: I didn't expect to win a prize myself. I'm so lucky!

examples.chinese: 农民在春天种植了很多蔬菜。
examples.pinyin: Nóngmín zài chūntiān zhòngzhíle hěnduō shūcài.
examples.english: The farmer planted many vegetables in spring.

examples.chinese: 这种咖啡很受欢迎，很多人都喜欢喝。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng kāfēi hěn shòu huānyíng, hěnduō rén dōu xǐhuān hē.
examples.english: This kind of coffee is very popular, and many people like to drink it.

examples.chinese: 随着练习的增加，他的中文逐渐变得更好了。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe liànxí de zēngjiā, tā de zhōngwén zhújiàn biàn de gèng hǎo le.
examples.english: As his practice increased, his Chinese gradually became better.

examples.chinese: 这个公司逐步改进了他们的产品质量。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngsī zhúbù gǎijìnle tāmen de chǎnpǐn zhìliàng.
examples.english: The company improved their product quality step by step.

examples.chinese: 这个包裹的重量超过了五公斤，所以邮费比较贵。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bāoguǒ de zhòngliàng chāoguòle wǔ gōngjīn, suǒyǐ yóufèi bǐjiào guì.
examples.english: This package's weight exceeds five kilograms, so the shipping fee is quite expensive.

examples.chinese: 我们的新主席在会议上宣布了一个重要的决定。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de xīn zhǔxí zài huìyì shang xuānbù le yī ge zhòngyào de juédìng.
examples.english: Our new chairwoman announced an important decision at the meeting.

examples.chinese: 祝福你在新的一年里身体健康，工作顺利。
examples.pinyin: Zhùfú nǐ zài xīn de yī nián lǐ shēntǐ jiànkāng, gōngzuò shùnlì.
examples.english: I wish you good health and smooth work in the new year.

examples.chinese: 这部电影的主题是关于家庭和友谊的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de zhǔtí shì guānyú jiātíng hé yǒuyì de.
examples.english: The theme of this movie is about family and friendship.

examples.chinese: 这位著名的演员在电影中表现得很出色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhùmíng de yǎnyuán zài diànyǐng zhōng biǎoxiàn de hěn chūcè.
examples.english: This famous actor performed excellently in the movie.

examples.chinese: 我们要抓紧时间完成这个项目，不然会很麻烦。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhuā jǐn shíjiān wánchéng zhège xiàngmù, búrán huì hěn máfan.
examples.english: We need to grasp the time firmly to complete this project, otherwise it will be very troublesome.

examples.chinese: 他在图书馆专心学习，不受任何干扰。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài túshūguǎn zhuānxīn xuéxí, búshòu rènhé gānrǎo.
examples.english: He studied concentratedly in the library without any distractions.

examples.chinese: 他转动了一下方向盘，车子就向左转去。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhuǎndòng le yīxià fāngxiàngpán, chēzi jiù xiàng zuǒ zhuǎn qù.
examples.english: He turned the steering wheel slightly, and the car turned to the left.

examples.chinese: 这位作家的著作被翻译成了许多种语言。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā de zhùzuò bèi fānyì chéngle xǔduō zhǒng yǔyán.
examples.english: This writer's compositions have been translated into many languages.

examples.chinese: 请你把这个消息转告给李明，他今天可能不会来上班。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ zhège xiāoxī zhuǎngào gěi Lǐ Míng, tā jīntiān kěnéng búhuì lái shàngbān.
examples.english: Please pass this message on to Li Ming that he probably won't come to work today.

examples.chinese: 他听到我的声音后转身走了过来。
examples.pinyin: Tā tīngdào wǒ de shēngyīn hòu zhuǎnshēn zǒu le guòlái.
examples.english: After hearing my voice, he turned around and walked over to me.

examples.chinese: 在这个十字路口向左转弯，然后直走就能看到医院。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège shízì lùkǒu xiàng zuǒ zhuǎn wān, ránhòu zhí走jiù néng kàndào yīyuàn.
examples.english: Turn left at this intersection, then go straight and you'll see the hospital.

examples.chinese: 我们的新房子需要装修，所以下个月才能搬进去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de xīn fángzi xūyào zhuāngxiū, suǒyǐ xiàge yuè cái néng bān進qu.
examples.english: Our new house needs renovation, so we can't move in until next month.

examples.chinese: 工厂里安装了一个新的生产装置。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchǎng lǐ ānzhuāngle yīgè xīn de shēngchǎn zhuāngzhì.
examples.english: The factory installed a new production device.

examples.chinese: 由于天气恶劣，比赛的地点转移到了室内体育馆。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì èliè, bǐsài de dìdiǎn zhuǎnyí dàole shìnèi tǐyù guǎn.
examples.english: Due to bad weather, the venue of the competition was shifted to the indoor gymnasium.

examples.chinese: 他每天都准时到达办公室，从不迟到。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu zhǔnshí dàodá bàngōngshì, cóng bù chídào.
examples.english: He arrives at the office on time every day and is never late.

examples.chinese: 她一直追求自己的梦想，从不放弃。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīzhí zhuīqiú zìjǐ de mengxiang, cóngbù fàngqì.
examples.english: She has always pursued her own dreams and never given up.

examples.chinese: 我需要查阅一些关于这个项目的资料。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào chákè yīxiē guānyú zhège xiàngmù de zīliào.
examples.english: I need to look up some information about this project.

examples.chinese: 这个想法是我自己想出来的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎngfǎ shì wǒ zìjǐ xiǎng chūlái de.
examples.english: This idea came from my own thinking.

examples.chinese: 我们的公司需要更多的资源来完成这个项目。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de gōngsī xūyào gèngduō de zīyuán lái wánchéng zhège xiàngmù.
examples.english: Our company needs more resources to complete this project.

examples.chinese: 这个单词中有三个字母是重复的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dāncí zhōng yǒu sān ge zìmǔ shì chóngfù de.
examples.english: There are three letters in this word that are repeated.

examples.chinese: 这个综合医院的设备很先进，医生也很专业。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zōnghé yīyuàn de shèbèi hěn xiānnjìn, yīshēng yě hěn zhuānyè.
examples.english: This comprehensive hospital has advanced equipment and very professional doctors.

examples.chinese: 他在比赛前很自信，相信自己能赢。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bǐsài qián hěn zìxìn, xiāngxìn zìjǐ néng yíng.
examples.english: He was very confident before the competition and believed he could win.

examples.chinese: 这次旅行总共花了我三千块钱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng zǒnggòng huāle wǒ sānqiān kuài qián.
examples.english: This trip cost me three thousand yuan in all.

examples.chinese: 总理在会议上宣布了新的经济政策。
examples.pinyin: Zǒnglǐ zài huìyì shang xuānbù le xīn de jīngjì zhèngcè.
examples.english: The premier announced a new economic policy at the conference.

examples.chinese: 美国的新总统今年上台了。
examples.pinyin: Měiguó de xīn zǒngtǒng jīnnián shàngtái le.
examples.english: The new president of the United States took office this year.

examples.chinese: 这个项目很复杂，有很多问题需要解决，但总之我们必须在下个月完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù hěn fùzá, yǒu hěnduō wèntí xūyào jiějué, dàn zǒngzhī wǒmen bìxū zài xiàge yuè wánchéng.
examples.english: This project is complicated with many problems to solve, but in a word, we must finish it next month.

examples.chinese: 我们必须阻止这个问题继续恶化。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū zǔzhǐ zhège wèntí jìxù è huà.
examples.english: We must prevent this problem from getting worse.

examples.chinese: 他吃饭的时候嘴巴很脏，妈妈让他擦一擦。
examples.pinyin: Tā chīfàn de shíhou zuǐba hěn zāng, māma ràng tā cā yī cā.
examples.english: His jaw/mouth was very dirty while eating, and his mom told him to wipe it.

examples.chinese: 经理在会议上作出了一个重要的决定。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ zài huìyì shang zuòchūle yī ge zhòngyào de juéding.
examples.english: The manager made an important decision at the meeting.

examples.chinese: 作为一个学生，我需要认真对待每一次考试。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi yīgè xuésheng, wǒ xūyào rènzhēn duìdài měi yī cì kǎoshì.
examples.english: As a student, I need to take every exam seriously.

examples.chinese: 最初我不想去参加这个聚会,但后来我改变了主意。
examples.pinyin: Zuìchū wǒ búxiǎng qù cānjiā zhège jùhuì, dàn hòulái wǒ gǎibiàn le zhǔyì.
examples.english: At first I didn't want to go to this party, but later I changed my mind.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上我做梦梦到自己在飞。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ zuòmèng mèngdào zìjǐ zài fēi.
examples.english: Last night I dreamed that I was flying.
